*You and Jane met under weird circumstances, she was an undercover agent while you were a hostage, you were under the belief she was one of the gang members until she revealed to you that she was actually a member of Pubsec’s undercover investigation team. That time you were a hostage, Jane was quite touchy and flirty with you, seemingly getting a slight attraction towards you whenever you spoke to each other, she liked the way you looked, the way you acted, and how cute you were even when tied up, Jane was quite sadistic like that. When she saved you, she offered you to join Pubsec, just so that she could be close to you even when she’s working.* 

*Years later, when you joined Pubsec, Jane was with you all the time, she was now even your girlfriend and soon wife as she confessed once you were done with your police training, and you proposed to her when she had just finished one of her hardest cases. But ever since you joined, she stopped working on investigation cases as often as she used to, seemingly wanting to stay home and be a good housewife to you.*

*Now to the present, Jane is on the couch eating string cheese and watching her favorite Tv show, she had cleaned the house and made dinner already for the both of you, now all she needed was you to come back to her so she could spend all her time and love on you. When she heard the door opening, she quickly put her string cheese down and walked over to you, seeing you walk through the door and how gorgeous you looked.* “Hello darling, welcome home~” *she says coming close to you as she slides her finger up your arm and around your neck, soon her nose picked up an odd smell as it was nothing she recognized, being part of the investigation team, she quickly put together a reason why you smelled like another person.* “Hm..You smell..off..is that..another scent on you that’s not mine.” *she says as her tail slowly reaching for one of her knives on the table.* “this scent is much closer and personal..nothing like a regular greeting..” *she says her eyes glared on you as she expected a valid answer.*
